item.title: Kookmin University College of Design Elevates Projects through Advanced Craft Specialist Training Program (국민대 조형대학, 공예전문인력양성 심화과정을 통한 프로젝트 고도화)
item.description:
Kookmin University (President Jung Seung-ryul) College of Design's Department of Ceramic Arts and Department of Metal & Jewelry Arts have completed the practical training phase of the '2026 Craft Specialist Training Education Program (Practical & Advanced) Planning and Operation Project' and will enter the advanced education phase starting in October. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 조형대학 도자공예학과와 금속공예학과가 ‘2026 공예전문인력양성 교육프로그램(실무·심화) 기획 및 운영 사업’의 실무교육을 마무리하고 오는 10월부터 심화교육 단계에 들어간다.)

This project, hosted by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and organized by the Korea Craft and Design Culture Promotion Agency, was established to cultivate specialized professionals in the planning, education, and distribution sectors that connect craft makers, consumers, and the market, in response to the diversification of craft culture demand and the specialization of related job roles. Kookmin University was selected as the operating institution this year and is running the 'CRAFT ON LIVE; MARKET-ABLE' program. (문화체육관광부가 주최하고 한국공예·디자인문화진흥원이 주관하는 이번 사업은 공예문화 수요의 다변화와 관련 직무의 전문화에 대응해 공예 제작자와 소비자, 시장을 연결하는 기획·교육·유통 분야의 전문인력을 양성하기 위해 마련됐다. 국민대는 올해 수행기관으로 선정돼 ‘크래프트 온 라이브; 마켓-에이블(CRAFT ON LIVE; MARKET-ABLE)’ 프로그램을 운영하고 있다.)

After recruiting participants from June 12 to June 26, Kookmin University conducted practical training from July 18 to September 19. Subsequently, advanced education will run from October 10 to December 5, with the aim of connecting the skills learned during the practical course to real-world project planning and execution. (국민대는 지난 6월 12일부터 26일까지 참가자를 모집한 뒤 7월 18일부터 9월 19일까지 실무교육을 진행한다. 이어 10월 10일부터 12월 5일까지 심화교육을 운영해 실무과정에서 익힌 내용을 실제 프로젝트 기획과 실행으로 연결할 예정이다.)

In particular, the advanced education focuses on concretizing participants' expertise in each field: craft curators (exhibition and cultural content planning), craft merchandisers (product and distribution planning), and craft educators (education and program planning). Building on the theory and field experience acquired during practical training, participants will develop their projects through expert mentoring to enhance the completeness of their plans and their applicability in the field. (특히 심화교육은 공예 큐레이터(전시·문화콘텐츠 기획), 공예 머천다이저(상품·유통 기획), 공예 에듀케이터(교육·프로그램 기획) 등 각 분야별로 참가자들의 전문성을 구체화하는 데 중점을 둔다. 실무교육에서 습득한 이론과 현장 경험을 바탕으로 프로젝트를 발전시키고, 전문가 멘토링을 통해 기획의 완성도와 현장 적용 가능성을 높이는 방식으로 진행될 예정이다.)

The program involves approximately 30 external working professionals and a research team of seven, including Professors Park Jung-won and Ahn Jung-hyun from the Department of Ceramic Arts, Professors Hyun Ji-yeon and Lee Seung-yeol from the Department of Metal & Jewelry Arts, Professor Myung Yun-kyung from the Department of Visual Design, Adjunct Professor Jung Mi-sung from the Department of Ceramic Arts, and Adjunct Professor Choi Yoon-jung from the Department of Metal & Jewelry Arts. Kookmin University has structured the curriculum so that the practical and advanced courses progress in stages, linking the university's expertise in craft education with the experience of field specialists. (프로그램에는 약 30명의 외부 실무전문가와 도자공예학과 박중원·안정현 교수, 금속공예학과 현지연·이승열 교수, 시각디자인학과 명윤경 교수, 도자공예학과 정미성 겸임교수, 금속공예학과 최윤정 겸임교수 등 7명의 연구진이 참여한다. 국민대는 대학의 공예교육 전문성과 현장 전문가의 경험을 연계해 실무과정과 심화과정이 단계적으로 이어질 수 있도록 교육과정을 구성했다.)

Kookmin University College of Design has accumulated educational, research, and production capabilities in the craft field over the past 50 years, and is continuing this year's program based on its experience running the 'Craft Intermediary Talent Training Project' in 2021 and 2022 and the 'Craft Specialist Training Project' in 2025. (국민대 조형대학은 지난 50여 년간 공예 분야의 교육·연구·제작 역량을 축적해왔으며, 2021·2022년 ‘공예매개인력양성사업’과 2025년 ‘공예전문인력양성사업’을 운영한 경험을 바탕으로 올해 프로그램을 이어가고 있다.)

A Kookmin University official stated, "If the practical training was a process of understanding the planning, educational, and distribution structures and the field of the craft industry, the advanced education starting in October is the stage where participants concretize the experience they have accumulated into actual projects," adding, "Through field-specific mentoring and project execution, we plan to support participants in further developing their individual expertise." (국민대 관계자는 “실무교육이 공예산업의 기획·교육·유통 구조와 현장을 이해하는 과정이었다면, 10월부터 진행되는 심화교육은 참가자들이 그동안 축적한 경험을 실제 프로젝트로 구체화하는 단계”라며 “분야별 멘토링과 프로젝트 수행을 통해 참가자들이 각자의 전문성을 보다 구체적으로 발전시킬 수 있도록 지원할 계획”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Explaining Research in '3-Minute English'... 2nd K-3MT Finals Held (연구를 ‘3분 영어’로 설명하다… 제2회 K-3MT 결승전 개최)
item.description:
Korea University (President Kim Dong-won) Graduate School Innovation Headquarters held the finals of the '2026 Academic Year 2nd K-3MT Competition' on Wednesday, the 2nd, at 10 a.m. in the International Teleconference Room of the Centennial Memorial Samsung Hall, where graduate students present their research in English within three minutes using a single slide. (고려대학교 (총장 김동원) 대학원혁신본부는 2일(수) 오전 10시 백주년기념삼성관 국제원격회의실에서 대학원생이 자신의 연구를 슬라이드 한 장으로 3분 이내 영어로 발표하는 ‘2026학년도 제2회 K-3MT Competition’ 결승전을 개최했다.)

Fifteen graduate students who advanced through the preliminary rounds competed in the finals, and the Grand Prize was awarded to Choi Ju-young (Master's student, Department of Food and Resource Economics). (예선을 거친 15명의 대학원생이 결승전에 올랐으며, 대상은 최주영(식품자원경제학과 석사과정) 학생이 수상했다.)

K-3MT is a competition that tests presentation skills in effectively conveying specialized research to the public. Starting this year, the rank of the Grand Prize has been elevated to the Korea University President's Award. The Excellence Award went to Yoon Jae-hyun (Master's student, Department of Mechanical Engineering), the Encouragement Award to Min Ji-yong (Combined Master's-PhD student, Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering), and the Popularity Award to Jeon Su-yeon (Master's student, Department of Information Security). (K-3MT는 전문적인 연구 내용을 대중에게 효과적으로 전달하는 발표 역량을 겨루는 대회다. 올해부터 대상 훈격이 고려대 총장상으로 격상됐다. 우수상은 윤재현(기계공학과 석사과정), 장려상은 민지용(전기전자공학과 석박통합과정), 인기상은 전수연(정보보호학과 석사과정) 학생이 각각 수상했다.)

The three winners of the Grand Prize, Excellence Award, and Encouragement Award will represent Korea University at the BK21 K-3MT Competition, which involves 28 universities nationwide. The in-person national finals will be held at Korea University on November 11, and the national Grand Prize winner will receive the Minister of Education Award. (대상·우수상·장려상 수상자 3명은 고려대 대표로 전국 28개 대학이 참여하는 BK21 K-3MT Competition에 참가한다. 오는 11월 11일 고려대에서 대면 결승이 열리며, 전국대회 대상 수상자에게는 교육부 장관상이 수여된다.)

Min Ji-yong, winner of the Encouragement Award, will also participate in the Asia-Pacific 3MT Competition as a Korea University representative, in accordance with the rule that only PhD students may enter. That competition is an international event hosted by Australia's University of Queensland, which first introduced the 3MT format. (장려상 수상자인 민지용 학생은 박사과정생만 참가할 수 있는 규정에 따라 고려대 대표로 Asia-Pacific 3MT Competition에도 참가한다. 이 대회는 3MT를 처음 도입한 호주 퀸즐랜드대가 주관하는 국제대회다.)

The Korea University Graduate School Innovation Headquarters plans to expand related programs to help graduate students effectively communicate their research and enhance communication capabilities between researchers and the public. (고려대 대학원혁신본부는 앞으로도 대학원생들이 자신의 연구를 효과적으로 전달하고 연구자와 대중의 소통 역량을 높일 수 있도록 관련 프로그램을 확대할 계획이다.)

item.title: Sahmyook University Begins Accepting Rolling Admissions Applications on the 7th… Expands Essay-Based Admissions Significantly (삼육대, 7일부터 수시모집 원서접수… 논술전형 대폭 확대한다)
item.description:
Sahmyook University (President Je Hae-jong) will accept applications for its 2027 academic year rolling admissions from the 7th to the 11th via Jinhak Apply. (삼육대(총장 제해종)는 2027학년도 수시모집 원서접수를 오는 7일부터 11일까지 진학어플라이에서 실시한다.)

A total of 1,029 students will be selected, a sharp increase of 24.73% (204 more) compared to last year's 825. As a result, rolling admissions now account for nearly 80% of the total admissions quota. (선발 인원은 1029명으로, 전년도 825명 대비 24.73%(204명↑) 대폭 증가했다. 이에 따라 전체 모집 인원 중 수시가 차지하는 비중이 80%에 육박하게 됐다.)

The most notable change in this year's rolling admissions is the expansion of the 'Essay Excellence Track.' Except for the Department of Theology and arts and physical education majors, 277 students will be selected across all departments—an increase of 79.87% (123 more) from last year's 154. This is the largest scale among all admissions tracks, solidifying its status as Sahmyook University's flagship admissions program. The College of Pharmacy, which draws attention from top-tier applicants, is also introducing its essay-based admissions track for the first time this year, recruiting 5 students. (올해 수시모집에서 가장 두드러진 변화는 ‘논술우수자전형’의 확대다. 신학과와 예체능계열을 제외한 전 학과에서 전년(154명) 대비 79.87%(123명↑) 증가한 277명을 선발한다. 이는 모든 전형을 통틀어 가장 큰 규모로, 명실상부 삼육대의 대표 전형으로 자리매김했다. 최상위권 수험생들의 이목이 쏠리는 약학과도 올해 처음으로 논술전형을 도입해 5명을 모집한다.)

The Essay Excellence Track does not consider high school records at all, selecting successful candidates solely based on 100% of their essay test scores. The minimum college scholastic ability test (CSAT) requirement has also been lowered to within grade 3 in one subject among Korean, English, Mathematics, and one elective subject for general departments, significantly reducing the burden on applicants. Satisfying the requirement with a single elective subject is possible. (논술우수자전형은 학생부 성적을 전혀 반영하지 않고 오직 논술고사 성적 100%로 합격자를 가린다. 수능최저학력기준 역시 일반학과 기준 국어·영어·수학·탐구(1과목) 중 1개 영역 3등급 이내로 설정돼 수험생의 부담을 크게 낮췄다. 탐구 1과목으로도 충족이 가능하다.)

This is considered a so-called 'chance for a comeback' for mid-tier applicants with high school records or CSAT mock test scores at or below grade 3 to gain admission to a university in the Seoul area. However, for the College of Pharmacy, applicants must achieve a combined grade of 5 or lower across three subjects out of Korean, English, Mathematics (Calculus or Geometry), and one science elective. (이에 내신이나 수능 모의고사 3등급 이하의 중위권 수험생에게는 서울권 대학 진학을 위한 이른바 ‘역전의 기회’로 평가된다. 단, 약학과는 국어·영어·수학(미적분 또는 기하)·과탐(1과목) 중 3개 영역 합 5등급 이내를 충족해야 한다.)

The fact that the essay test is administered in a 'compact essay' format is also noteworthy. Compared to traditional verbal or mathematical essays, the questions are simpler and the required response length is shorter, reducing the burden on applicants. Questions are designed around the standard high school curriculum and EBS materials linked to the CSAT, making them solvable without additional private tutoring—so any student who has diligently prepared through school classes and the CSAT can apply without difficulty. (논술고사가 ‘약술형 논술’ 형식으로 출제된다는 점도 주목할 만하다. 기존 언어논술이나 수리논술에 비해 문항이 단순하고 답안 분량이 짧아 수험생의 부담이 덜하다. 고등학교 정규 교육과정과 EBS 수능 연계 교재를 중심으로 별도의 사교육 없이 풀 수 있는 난이도로 출제돼 학교 수업과 수능을 충실히 준비한 수험생이라면 누구나 무리 없이 도전할 수 있다.)

For general departments, applicants solve a total of 13 questions in Korean and Mathematics over 80 minutes. The number of questions has been reduced from 15 last year to 13 this year, alleviating time pressure. The College of Pharmacy, which administers a separate test, has 8 questions in Mathematics alone, with the same 80-minute duration. (일반학과의 경우 국어와 수학 총 13문항을 80분간 푼다. 문항 수가 지난해 15문항에서 올해 13문항으로 줄어 시간 압박을 덜게 됐다. 별도로 고사를 치르는 약학과는 수학 단일 과목으로 8문항이 출제되며, 고사 시간은 80분으로 같다.)

Seum Talent Track conducts interviews… Only College of Pharmacy has CSAT minimum requirement (세움인재 면접 실시… 수능최저는 약학과만)

The Seum Talent Track (comprehensive admissions) selects 231 students. In the first stage, candidates are selected at 4 times the quota based 100% on document evaluation, and in the second stage, 60% of the first-stage score and 40% of the interview score are combined. Document evaluation qualitatively assesses the contents recorded in the high school records using criteria such as academic ability, career competency, and community competency. (세움인재전형(종합전형)은 231명을 선발한다. 1단계에서 서류평가 100%로 4배수를 선발하고, 2단계에서 1단계 성적 60%와 면접 40%를 합산한다. 서류평가는 학생부에 기록된 내용을 학업역량, 진로역량, 공동체역량 등 평가항목을 기준으로 종합 정성평가한다.)

The second-stage interview is conducted by verifying the contents of the document evaluation based on the high school records without any provided passages, using individual questions. Each interview lasts no more than 8 minutes. All interviews are subject to blind processing, including the applicant's exam number, name, school of origin, and information about parents or relatives. Mentioning such details may lead to disadvantages, so caution is required. (2단계 면접은 제시문 없이 학생부를 기반으로 서류평가 내용을 확인하고 개별 질문하는 방식이다. 시간은 8분 이내다. 모든 면접은 수험번호를 포함해 수험생의 이름, 출신학교, 부모 및 친인척 정보 등이 블라인드 처리된다. 이를 언급하면 불이익을 받을 수 있으니 각별히 유의해야 한다.)

The CSAT minimum requirement for the Seum Talent Track applies only to the College of Pharmacy, requiring a combined grade of 5 or lower across three subjects out of Korean, English, Mathematics (Calculus or Geometry), and one science elective. (세움인재전형의 수능 최저학력기준은 약학과만 있다. 국어·영어·수학(미적분 또는 기하)·과탐(1과목) 중 3개 영역 합 5등급 이내다.)

Principal's Recommendation Track '100% school records'… Applies '5-grade scale' for high school grades (학교장추천 ‘교과 100%’… ‘내신 5등급제’ 적용)

The Principal's Recommendation Track, an academic records-based admissions path, recruits 131 students. Candidates are selected 100% based on high school subject grades, with scores from the first semester of the first year through the first semester of the third year reflected equally across all grade levels. A recommendation from the applicant's high school principal is required, but there is no limit on the number of recommended students per school. (교과전형인 학교장추천전형은 131명을 모집한다. 학생부 교과성적 100%로 선발하는 전형으로, 1학년 1학기부터 3학년 1학기까지 성적을 학년별 차등 없이 반영한다. 출신 고등학교장의 추천을 받아야 하지만, 고교별 추천 인원의 제한은 없다.)

The Department of Physical Education and the Department of Art & Design within the Principal's Recommendation Track also incorporate practical test scores. Physical Education combines 40% school records and 60% practical skills, while Art & Design combines 20% school records and 80% practical skills. (학교장추천전형의 체육학과와 아트앤디자인학과는 실기 성적도 반영한다. 체육학과는 학생부 40%, 실기 60%이며, 아트앤디자인학과는 학생부 20%, 실기 80%를 합산한다.)

The Principal's Recommendation Track has revamped how high school subject grades are calculated. The '5-grade scale' for internal grades, which will be fully introduced starting with the 2028 academic year admissions, has been applied one year early as a preemptive measure. The previous 9-grade scores are converted into five grades from A to E, assigning △grades 1-2 as A (100 points) △grades 3-4 as B (99 points) △grade 5 as C (98 points) △grades 6-7 as D (90 points) △grades 8-9 as E (70 points). (학교장추천전형은 학생부 교과 성적 반영 방식을 개편했다. 2028학년도 대입부터 전면 도입되는 ‘내신 5등급제’를 1년 앞당겨 선제적으로 적용한다. 기존 9등급제 점수를 A~E 5개 등급으로 환산해 △1~2등급 A(100점) △3~4등급 B(99점) △5등급 C(98점) △6~7등급 D(90점) △8~9등급 E(70점)를 부여한다.)

With the narrowed score gaps between grades, practical test scores are expected to become the decisive factor for admission to arts and physical education departments such as Art & Design and Physical Education, where practical components weigh heavily. However, the College of Pharmacy retains the previous 9-grade scale, as differentiation is essential due to the razor-thin margins that decide outcomes among top-tier applicants. (이처럼 등급 간 점수 격차가 완화됨에 따라, 실기 반영 비율이 높은 아트앤디자인학과와 체육학과 등 예체능 계열은 사실상 실기 성적이 합격의 결정적 변수가 될 전망이다. 단, 약학과는 기존 9등급제를 유지한다. 소수점 단위로 당락이 좌우되는 최상위권 특성상 변별력이 필수적이기 때문이다.)

The CSAT minimum requirement for the Principal's Recommendation Track requires general departments to achieve a combined grade of 7 or lower across two subjects out of Korean, English, Mathematics, and one elective subject; the Department of Nursing and the Department of Physical Therapy require a combined grade of 6 or lower across two subjects; and the College of Pharmacy requires a combined grade of 5 or lower across three subjects out of Korean, English, Mathematics (Calculus or Geometry), and one science elective. The Department of Physical Education and the Department of Art & Design have no CSAT minimum requirement. (학교장추천전형의 수능 최저학력기준은 일반학과의 경우 국어·영어·수학·탐구(1과목) 중 2개 영역 합 7등급 이내, 간호학과·물리치료학과는 2개 영역 합 6등급 이내, 약학과는 국어·영어·수학(미적분 또는 기하)·과탐(1과목) 중 3개 영역 합 5등급 이내여야 한다. 체육학과와 아트앤디자인학과는 수능최저학력기준이 없다.)

The College of Pharmacy will select 26 students through rolling admissions this year, an increase of 10 from last year's 16. The breakdown is: △Seum Talent Track (comprehensive) 7 students △Essay Excellence (essay) 5 students △Principal's Recommendation (school records) 3 students △Seventh-day Adventist Pastor's Recommendation (comprehensive) 3 students △Rural Areas (school records, outside quota) 3 students △Equal Opportunity II (comprehensive, outside quota) 3 students △Special Education Beneficiaries (comprehensive, outside quota) 2 students, among others. item.title: Kyung Hee University Opens Free Coding Classes for Middle School Students to Bring AI and SW Education to the Local Community (경희대, 중학생 대상 무료 코딩 교실 열어 지역사회에 AI·SW 교육)
item.description:
Kyung Hee University (President Kim Jin-sang)'s SW-centered University Project Group will operate free coding classes for middle school students. Lee Young-ho, a student in the Department of Software Convergence at Kyung Hee University and author of "I am an Entry Game Developer" and "I am an Entry Painter," will serve as the instructor directly. Instructors will be assigned to provide close guidance so that even students new to coding can easily participate. The coding classes will be held at the College of Electronics and Information Building on Kyung Hee University's International Campus and will be provided entirely free of charge. (경희대학교(총장 김진상) SW중심대학사업단이 중학생을 대상으로 무료 코딩 교실을 운영한다. 이번 프로그램은 『나는야 엔트리 게임 개발자』, 『나는야 엔트리 화가』의 저자인 경희대학교 소프트웨어융합학과 이영호 학생이 직접 강사로 참여한다. 코딩을 처음 배우는 학생도 쉽게 참여할 수 있도록 강사를 배치해 밀착 지도할 계획이다. 코딩 교실은 경희대 국제캠퍼스 전자정보대학관에서 열리며, 전액 무료로 진행된다.)

The classes will be held six times in total over September, with each session lasting three hours. Students will create seven games directly while learning core programming concepts such as variables, signals, coordinates, functions, loops, recursive functions, and lists. In the final two sessions, students will also have opportunities to design, build, and present their own games. (수업은 9월 중 총 6회에 걸쳐 매회 3시간씩 진행된다. 학생들은 7가지의 게임을 직접 만들며 변수, 신호, 좌표, 함수, 반복문, 재귀함수, 리스트 등 핵심 프로그래밍 개념을 익힌다. 마지막 2회 차에는 학생이 직접 게임을 기획·제작하고 발표하는 시간도 마련된다.)

Kyung Hee University's SW-centered University Project Group has been expanding cooperation with the local community through AI and software education and steadily broadening digital education opportunities. As an extension of this effort, the program has been designed as a sharing-based education model to widely spread outcomes to the local community and extend educational content to local schools and households. Jo Jin-seong, head of Kyung Hee University's SW-centered University Project Group, said, "This is a meaningful occasion where a university student author directly teaches coding to young people. We will continue to carry out various SW sharing programs in partnership with the local community." Lee Young-ho said, "Meeting students with the textbook I wrote and learning coding together is itself deeply meaningful." (경희대 SW중심대학사업단은 AI와 소프트웨어 교육을 통해 지역사회와의 협력을 확대하고, 디지털 교육 기회를 꾸준히 확대하고 있다. 이번 프로그램은 그 연장선으로 지역사회의 성과를 널리 확산하고, 교육 콘텐츠를 지역 학교와 가정으로까지 확산하는 공유형 교육으로 설계됐다. 조진성 경희대 SW중심대학사업단장은 “대학생 저자가 직접 청소년에게 코딩을 가르치는 뜻깊은 자리다. 앞으로도 지역사회와 함께하는 다양한 SW 나눔 프로그램을 이어가겠다”고 말했다. 이영호 학생은 “직접 쓴 교재로 학생들과 만나 코딩을 공부해 가는 과정 자체가 큰 의미가 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Seoul National University of Science and Technology and Doosan Enerbility Strengthen Technology Cooperation in Next-Generation Nuclear Power and SMR (서울과기대-두산에너빌리티, 차세대 원전·SMR 기술협력 강화)
item.description:
Seoul National University of Science and Technology (President Kim Dong-hwan, hereafter SeoulTech) and Doosan Enerbility Co., Ltd. will pursue industry-academia cooperation to strengthen technological competitiveness in nuclear design fields, including next-generation nuclear power plants and small modular reactors (SMR), and to foster specialized research personnel. (서울과학기술대학교(총장 김동환, 이하 서울과기대)와 두산에너빌리티㈜가 차세대 원전 및 소형모듈원자로(SMR) 등 원자력 설계 분야의 기술 경쟁력 강화와 전문 연구인력 양성을 위한 산학협력에 나선다.)

The two institutions signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on September 2 at SeoulTech to establish a foundation for research cooperation in the areas of core nuclear equipment technologies, innovative design, and reliability assessment. (양 기관은 9월 2일 서울과기대에서 원자력기기 핵심기술과 혁신설계, 신뢰성 평가 분야의 연구협력 기반 구축을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다.)

Attending the signing ceremony were officials from SeoulTech and representatives from Doosan Enerbility, including Managing Director Seo Young-bin of the Nuclear Design Division and General Manager Kim Jong-in, along with other officials from both institutions. (이날 협약식에는 서울과기대 관계자와 두산에너빌리티 원자력설계담당 서영빈 상무, 김종인 부장 등 양 기관 관계자들이 참석했다.)

This agreement was arranged to connect the research capabilities of both institutions in the nuclear design field with industrial expertise, and to establish a sustained cooperation framework for future joint research, technology development, and specialized workforce training. The agreement is not a commitment to specific research projects or business execution but is intended to lay the basic framework for identifying and advancing concrete cooperative initiatives going forward. (이번 협약은 원자력 설계 분야에서 양 기관이 보유한 연구역량과 산업현장의 전문성을 연계하고, 향후 공동연구와 기술개발 및 전문인력 양성을 위한 지속적인 협력체계를 구축하기 위해 마련됐다. 협약은 특정 연구과제나 사업 수행을 확정하는 방식이 아니라, 향후 구체적인 협력사업을 발굴·추진하기 위한 기본적인 협력의 틀을 마련하는 데 목적이 있다.)

Under the agreement, the two institutions will explore cooperation measures centered on ▲research collaboration and review of research service feasibility in core nuclear equipment technologies, innovative design, and reliability assessment ▲technology and personnel exchanges and shared use of research facilities ▲research infrastructure cooperation for establishing research hubs ▲operation of linked programs for specialized workforce training ▲and academic and technical exchanges such as seminars and symposiums. (협약에 따라 양 기관은 ▲원자력기기 핵심기술·혁신설계·신뢰성 평가 분야 연구협력 및 연구용역 가능성 검토 ▲기술·인력 교류 및 연구시설 공동 활용 ▲연구거점 구축을 위한 연구인프라 협력 ▲전문인력 양성을 위한 연계 프로그램 운영 ▲세미나·심포지엄 등 학술·기술 교류 등을 중심으로 협력 방안을 모색한다.)

In particular, SeoulTech plans to establish an industry-academia cooperation foundation that connects the university's research capabilities with the industrial expertise in nuclear power plant design accumulated by Doosan Enerbility, thereby supporting the advancement of design and evaluation technologies not only for large-scale nuclear plants but also for next-generation nuclear power and SMR fields. (특히 서울과기대는 대학의 연구역량과 두산에너빌리티가 축적해 온 원전 설계 분야의 산업 전문성을 연계함으로써 대형원전은 물론 차세대 원전과 SMR 분야의 설계·평가 기술 고도화를 뒷받침할 수 있는 산학협력 기반을 마련할 계획이다.)

Furthermore, the two institutions will cooperate in connecting industrial technology demands to research and education through joint research and technology and personnel exchanges, and in fostering outstanding research personnel equipped with practical capabilities in nuclear design and reliability assessment. Through these efforts, they aim to strengthen the industry-linked R&D talent development system and contribute to enhancing the technological competitiveness of the domestic nuclear industry. (또한 양 기관은 공동연구와 기술·인력 교류를 통해 산업현장의 기술수요를 연구와 교육에 연계하고, 원자력 설계 및 신뢰성 평가 분야의 실무역량을 갖춘 우수 연구인력 양성에도 협력할 예정이다. 이를 통해 산학연계형 연구개발 인재 양성체계를 강화하고 국내 원자력 산업의 기술 경쟁력 제고에 기여한다는 구상이다.)

President Kim Dong-hwan stated, "This agreement holds significance in that it combines the university's research capabilities with industrial expertise to enhance technological competitiveness in next-generation nuclear power and SMR fields and establishes a foundation for industry-academia cooperation to foster specialized talent who will lead the future nuclear industry." He added, "Based on SeoulTech's engineering and research capabilities, we will expand practical cooperation with industry to contribute to strengthening the competitiveness of the nation's nuclear industry." (김동환 총장은 “이번 협약은 대학이 보유한 연구역량과 산업현장의 전문성을 결합해 차세대 원전과 SMR 분야의 기술 경쟁력을 높이고, 미래 원자력 산업을 이끌 전문인재를 양성하기 위한 산학협력의 기반을 마련했다는 데 의미가 있다”며 “서울과기대가 가진 공학·연구 역량을 바탕으로 산업계와의 실질적인 협력을 확대해 국가 원자력 산업의 경쟁력 강화에 기여하겠다”고 말했다.)

Heo Nam-su, Dean of Academic Affairs at SeoulTech (Professor of the Department of Mechanical System Design Engineering), who is participating in the establishment of the Nuclear Innovation Design Center, stated, "With this agreement as an opportunity, we will revitalize research and technical exchanges with Doosan Enerbility in the nuclear design field and closely connect industrial technology demands with the university's research capabilities in next-generation nuclear power and SMR design and reliability assessment." He added, "We will continue to expand the cooperation foundation that links industry-academia joint research with specialized research personnel training." (원자력혁신설계센터 설립에 참여하고 있는 허남수 서울과기대 교무처장(기계시스템디자인공학과 교수)은 “이번 협약을 계기로 두산에너빌리티와 원자력 설계 분야의 연구·기술 교류를 활성화하고, 차세대 원전과 SMR 설계 및 신뢰성 평가 분야에서 산업현장의 기술수요와 대학의 연구역량을 긴밀하게 연계해 나가겠다”며 “산학 공동연구와 전문 연구인력 양성을 연계할 수 있는 협력 기반을 지속적으로 확대해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Seoul National University of Science and Technology, 28 Student Supporters Participate in SLW 2026... Contributing to the Expansion of Seoul's AI Innovation Ecosystem (서울과기대, SLW 2026 대학생 서포터즈 28명 참여… 서울 AI 혁신 생태계 확산에 힘 보탠다)
item.description:
Seoul National University of Science and Technology (President Kim Dong-hwan, hereafter SeoulTech) announced that 28 student supporters will participate in 'Smart Life Week (hereafter SLW) 2026', a global AI and smart city event organized by the Seoul AI Foundation. SLW 2026 will be held from October 6 to 8 at COEX in Seoul. (서울과학기술대학교(총장 김동환, 이하 서울과기대)는 서울AI재단이 주관하는 글로벌 AI·스마트도시 행사 ‘스마트라이프위크(Smart Life Week, 이하 SLW) 2026’에 대학생 서포터즈 28명이 참여한다고 밝혔다. SLW 2026은 오는 10월 6일부터 8일까지 서울 코엑스에서 열린다.)

SLW is a global comprehensive ICT event co-hosted by the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the World Smart Sustainable Cities Organization (WeGO), and organized by the Seoul AI Foundation. It features exhibitions, conferences, and business programs that explore citizens' lives and the future of cities based on AI. (SLW는 서울특별시와 세계스마트시티기구(WeGO)가 공동 주최하고 서울AI재단이 주관하는 글로벌 종합 ICT 행사로, AI를 기반으로 시민의 삶과 도시의 미래를 조망하는 전시·컨퍼런스·비즈니스 프로그램 등이 운영된다.)

The SeoulTech students received their appointment certificates at the 'SLW 2026 College Student Supporters Inauguration Ceremony' held on August 27, and completed preliminary training on international event operations, including event procedures and customer service. During the main event, they will take on various roles such as interpretation, on-site guidance for overseas city delegations, speakers, buyers, and domestic and international attendees, as well as event operation support and online promotional content creation. (서울과기대 학생들은 지난 8월 27일 열린 ‘SLW 2026 대학생 서포터즈 발대식’에서 위촉장을 수여받고, 행사 운영 절차와 서비스 응대 등 국제행사 실무를 위한 사전 교육을 이수했다. 본 행사에서는 해외 도시 대표단과 연사, 바이어, 국내외 참가자를 대상으로 통역과 현장 안내, 행사 운영 지원, 온라인 홍보 콘텐츠 제작 등 다양한 역할을 맡게 된다.)

This activity is expected to serve as an opportunity for students to directly guide foreign participants, interact with officials from countries and cities around the world, and develop international communication skills and on-site response capabilities. It is also expected to serve as a stepping stone for students to grow into talent equipped with practical experience spanning future industries and the public sector, by experiencing firsthand how AI technology translates into solving urban problems and improving citizens' quality of life. (이번 활동은 학생들이 외국인 참가자를 직접 안내하고 세계 각국·도시의 관계자들과 교류하며 국제적 소통 능력과 현장 대응 역량을 키우는 기회가 될 것으로 기대된다. 또한 AI 기술이 도시 문제 해결과 시민 삶의 질 향상으로 이어지는 실제 현장을 체험함으로써 미래 산업과 공공 분야를 아우르는 실무 감각을 갖춘 인재로 성장하는 발판이 될 것으로 보인다.)

This participation of supporters is also the first tangible outcome of the business agreement (MOU) signed between SeoulTech and the Seoul AI Foundation. The two institutions are jointly pursuing AI talent development, joint R&D based on public data, and the establishment of a region-linked collaboration platform, and plan to continue expanding students' hands-on experience in the AI field and international capabilities through this activity. (이번 서포터즈 참여는 서울과기대와 서울AI재단이 체결한 업무협약(MOU)의 실질적 첫 성과이기도 하다. 양 기관은 AI 인재양성, 공공데이터 기반 공동 R&D, 지역연계 협업 플랫폼 구축 등을 함께 추진하고 있으며, 이번 활동을 계기로 학생들의 AI 분야 현장 경험과 국제 역량을 지속적으로 확대해 나갈 계획이다.)

Kim Dong-ho, head of the ANCHOR Project Group at SeoulTech, stated, "Smart Life Week 2026 is a meaningful opportunity for students to experience the field of AI-based urban innovation firsthand and build global capabilities," adding, "We will continue our collaboration with the Seoul AI Foundation and actively contribute to the development of Seoul's AI innovation ecosystem." (김동호 서울과기대 ANCHOR 사업단장은 “스마트라이프위크 2026은 학생들이 AI 기반 도시 혁신의 현장을 직접 경험하고 글로벌 역량을 키울 수 있는 뜻깊은 자리”라며 “서울AI재단과의 협력을 이어가며 서울시 AI 혁신 생태계 발전에 적극 기여해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Soongsil University Establishes 'Digital Finance AI Department' Contract Department with Welcome Financial Group (숭실대, 웰컴금융그룹과 '디지털금융AI학과' 계약학과 신설)
item.description:
Soongsil University (President Lee Yoon-jae) announced that it has established a new master's-level contract department, the 'Department of Digital Finance AI,' in its general graduate school in partnership with Welcome Financial Group, with operations beginning in September 2026. (숭실대학교(총장 이윤재)는 웰컴금융그룹과 함께 일반대학원에 석사과정 계약학과인 ‘디지털금융AI학과’를 신설해 2026년 9월부터 운영한다고 밝혔다.)

The Department of Digital Finance AI is an industry-commissioned contract department based on the Higher Education Act, designed as an employee-focused master's program that enables Welcome Financial Group staff to systematically acquire advanced AI expertise while continuing their work duties. The two institutions had been discussing the establishment of the department since 2025 and, after completing the reporting procedure with the Ministry of Education, signed a memorandum of understanding on September 1, 2026. (디지털금융AI학과는 고등교육법에 근거한 산업체 위탁 계약학과로, 웰컴금융그룹 임직원이 현업을 수행하면서 AI 전문 역량을 체계적으로 갖출 수 있도록 설계된 재직자 중심 석사과정이다. 양 기관은 2025년부터 학과 신설을 논의해 왔으며, 교육부 신고 절차를 마치고 2026년 9월 1일 업무양해각서를 체결했다.)

Classes are held on weekday evenings (19:00–21:50) and Saturdays to accommodate the working conditions of employees. Students complete at least 24 credits over four semesters, pass a comprehensive exam, and submit a graduation thesis to earn a master's degree. (수업은 재직자의 근무 여건을 고려해 평일 야간(19:00~21:50)과 토요일에 진행된다. 4개 학기 동안 24학점 이상을 이수하고 종합시험과 졸업논문을 거쳐 석사학위를 취득한다.)

The curriculum is characterized by its focus on strengthening practical skills for applying AI technology in the financial field. In the first semester, four courses are offered for immediate application in financial practice: ▲AI Business Strategy & Financial Application ▲Practical Use of Generative AI ▲Data-Driven Decision Making ▲AI Service Architecture. In subsequent semesters, courses such as ▲Strategies for Building and Operating Finance-Specialized LLMs ▲AI Governance & Regulatory Response ▲AI Organization Management & Control Tower ▲AI-Based Financial Data Platform Strategy ▲Financial Regulations and Standards for Generative AI Use ▲AI Agent Design and Operation are offered sequentially. (교육과정은 AI 기술을 금융 현장에 활용하는 실무 역량 강화에 초점을 맞춘 것이 특징이다. 금융 실무에 바로 적용할 수 있도록 1학기에는 ▲AI 비즈니스 전략 & 금융 적용 ▲생성형 AI 실무 활용 ▲데이터 기반 의사결정 ▲AI 서비스 아키텍처 등 4개 교과목이 개설된다. 이후 학기에는 ▲금융특화 LLM 구축 및 운영 전략 ▲AI 거버넌스 & 규제 대응 ▲AI 조직 운영 & 컨트롤타워 ▲AI기반 금융 데이터 플랫폼 전략 ▲금융규제와 생성형 AI 활용 기준 ▲AI Agent 설계 및 운영 등이 순차적으로 운영된다.)

Faculty from across the university's AI and finance disciplines will participate in running the department, including those from the AI Software Division and the Department of Information Security within the College of AI, the Division of Business Administration at the College of Business, and the Department of AI Convergence Security at the AI Graduate School. Expertise is broadly distributed across fields such as AI security, natural language processing and foundation models, edge AI, digital marketing, and information security, enabling education that bridges technology and business. (학과 운영에는 AI대학의 AI소프트웨어학부, 정보보호학과, 경영대학 경영학부, AI전문대학원의 AI융합보안학과 등 교내 AI·금융 분야 교원이 참여한다. AI보안, 자연어처리·파운데이션 모델, 엣지 AI, 디지털마케팅, 정보보호 등 전공 분야가 폭넓게 배치돼 기술과 비즈니스를 아우르는 교육이 가능하도록 했다.)

Soongsil University established the nation's first Department of Electronic Computing in 1970 and launched the country's first IT college, leading the way in IT education. Starting in the 2026 academic year, the university operates the 'College of AI' and 'AI Graduate School,' the first AI-specialized colleges in Korea. Through the establishment of this new department, the university plans to expand hands-on, practice-oriented education that connects its AI educational and research capabilities with the financial industry. (숭실대는 1970년 국내 최초로 전자계산학과를 설립하고 국내 최초 IT대학을 출범시키며 IT 교육을 선도해 왔다. 2026학년도부터는 국내 최초의 AI 특화 단과대학인 ‘AI대학’과 ‘AI전문대학원’을 신설해 운영하고 있다. 이번 학과 신설을 통해 숭실대의 AI 교육·연구 역량을 금융 산업 현장과 연계한 실무 중심 교육을 확대할 계획이다.)

Vice President for Academic Affairs Jang Kyung-nam said, "Generative AI is reshaping product development, risk management, and customer touchpoints across the financial industry," adding, "The Department of Digital Finance AI is a program that brings real-world workplace challenges directly into the classroom to solve them, producing talent who understand both finance and AI." (장경남 학사부총장은 "생성형 AI는 금융 산업의 상품 개발과 리스크 관리, 고객 접점 전반을 다시 설계하게 만들고 있다"며 "디지털금융AI학과는 현업의 문제를 그대로 강의실로 가져와 풀어내는 과정으로, 금융과 AI를 동시에 이해하는 인재를 배출하겠다"고 말했다.)

Lim Hyun-sik, Head of Management Support at Welcome Savings Bank, stated, "AI transformation is not just a challenge for a specific organization but a capability issue for the entire company," and added, "We will continue to support our employees in gaining deep expertise through the degree program and applying it to their work." (임현식 웰컴저축은행 경영지원본부장은 "AI 전환은 특정 조직만의 과제가 아니라 회사 전체의 역량 문제"라며 "임직원이 학위과정을 통해 깊이 있는 전문성을 쌓고 이를 현업에 반영할 수 있도록 지속적으로 지원하겠다"고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies Holds Plaque Ceremony for 'Americas Global Center'... Opens Global Education Platform Spanning North and South America (사이버한국외국어대학교 ‘미주글로벌센터’ 현판식 개최…북·남미 아우르는 글로벌 교육 플랫폼 개소)
item.description:
Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (hereinafter referred to as Cyber Hankuk Foreign University, President Moon Hwi-chang) announced that it recently held a plaque ceremony for the Americas Global Center, which will oversee the spread of K-Education across the Americas and support education for overseas Koreans, based in New York. (사이버한국외국어대학교(이하 사이버한국외대, 총장 문휘창)가 최근 뉴욕을 거점으로 미주 지역 내 K-Education 확산과 재외동포 교육 지원을 총괄할 미주글로벌센터 현판식을 거행했다고 밝혔다.)

At the ceremony held on August 20 local time at the Korean Association of New York building in Chelsea, New York, attendees including Cyber Hankuk Foreign University President Moon Hwi-chang, Americas Global Center Director Choi Seung-hyun, and New York Korean Association President Lee Myeong-seok, along with representatives of major local organizations, gathered to celebrate the center's new beginning. (현지 시각으로 지난 8월 20일, 뉴욕 첼시에 위치한 뉴욕한인회관에서 열린 현판식 행사에는 사이버한국외대 문휘창 총장 및 최승현 미주글로벌센터장을 포함해 이명석 뉴욕한인회장 등 현지 주요 단체 관계자들이 한자리에 모여 센터의 새로운 시작을 축하했다.)

Following the university's first Americas Global Center established in Los Angeles in 2020, this second Americas Global Center opened in New York will serve as an overseas campus expanding its reach not only across the United States but also to Korean communities in Canada and Latin America. The center is expected to serve as a forward base for spreading the university's excellent educational content—designed to elevate the academic and professional capabilities of overseas Koreans—throughout the region. (지난 2020년 LA에 개소한 사이버한국외대의 첫 미주글로벌센터에 이어 두 번째로 뉴욕에 문을 연 미주글로벌센터는 미국 현지는 물론 캐나다와 중남미 지역 동포 사회까지 세를 확장하는 해외 캠퍼스의 역할을 수행하게 된다. 센터는 재외동포들의 학술적·직무적 역량을 끌어올릴 사이버한국외대의 우수한 교육 콘텐츠를 현지에 확산시키는 전초기지로 활용될 예정이다.)

In his commemorative address, Cyber Hankuk Foreign University President Moon Hwi-chang stated, "The newly launched Americas Global Center in New York will serve as a truly international-scale strategic education hub and a core platform for enhancing the quality of life for overseas Koreans and spreading outstanding K-Education," adding, "We will work closely with major institutions in the Korean-American community, such as the Korean Association and the Korean American Chamber of Commerce, to build an educational ecosystem that truly meets your needs." (문휘창 사이버한국외대 총장은 기념사를 통해 “이번에 출범한 뉴욕의 미주글로벌센터는 명실상부한 국제적 규모의 전략적 교육 거점으로서 재외동포들의 삶의 질을 높이고 우수한 K-Education을 확산시키는 핵심 플랫폼이 될 것”이라며 “한인회와 한인상공회의소 등 미주 동포 사회의 주요 기관들과 긴밀히 협력하여 여러분에게 꼭 필요한 교육 생태계를 만들어 가겠다”고 전했다.)

item.title: Kyung Hee University College of Fine Arts 60th Anniversary Exhibition 'Time Archive 60, Declaring Again' Opens (경희대 미술대학 설립 60주년 기념展 ‘Time Archive 60, 다시 선언하다’ 개최)
item.description:
Kyung Hee University (President Kim Jin-sang) College of Fine Arts is holding the 'Kyung Hee University College of Fine Arts 60th Anniversary Commemoration: TIME ARCHIVE 60, Declaring Again.' The exhibition will run for ten days from Monday, September 14 through Wednesday, September 23 across all floors from the 1st to the 4th of the Kyung Hee University Art Museum KUMA. This large-scale exhibition reflects on the artistic achievements and educational history of the College of Fine Arts over the past half-century and presents a creative vision for the next 100 years. The exhibition is designed to reinterpret the 60-year history of the College of Fine Arts, which has produced numerous masters and emerging artists at the center of Korean contemporary art since its founding in 1966, and to create a venue for creative connection across generations encompassing faculty, alumni, and current students. <<> 138 masters and emerging artists under one roof... A grand archival exhibition spanning every floor <<> A total of 138 artists, including current faculty, honorary and chair professors, alumni artists, and undergraduate and graduate students, take part in this 60th anniversary exhibition. Alongside masters representing Korean contemporary art, emerging artists who have just entered the art world and are actively creating works also join, presenting a diverse artistic spectrum. <<> From the 1st to the 3rd floors of the KUMA Art Museum, a unified comprehensive alumni exhibition is arranged. A route centered on representative works is established to offer a sweeping view of 60 years of Kyung Hee art, with high-quality works spanning all fields of contemporary art—painting, sculpture, and media—welcoming visitors. <<> 'Records of Taste' co-organized with the Korean Artists Support Solidarity and a youth essay contest <<> On the 4th floor of the museum, the special exhibition 'Records of Taste – Today's Artists, Tomorrow's Collection,' co-organized with the Korean Artists Support Solidarity, is presented. Fresh works by 35 emerging artists selected by the solidarity (including 20 Kyung Hee alumni) are on display, serving as a channel of communication that inspires the creative drive of emerging artists and lowers the threshold for art collecting. <<> In addition, a 'Records of Taste Art Appreciation Essay Contest' is held for students and the general public, including elementary, middle, and high schools under the Kyung Hee Academy, to discover next-generation art talent. Through rigorous screening by full-time faculty of the College of Fine Arts and the Korean Artists Support Solidarity, awards such as the President's Award and the Dean's Award will be conferred. The award ceremony takes place on Monday, September 28 at 5 p.m. On the 5th floor of the art museum, special lectures on how to write art appreciation essays and art collecting education programs for visitors and youth will also be offered. <<> Sharing through art, building a development fund and strengthening alumni networks <<> Through this exhibition, the College of Fine Arts has set the goal of 'raising a development fund' to support scholarships for future generations and improve the educational environment. Participating artists join in the meaningful purpose of the 60th anniversary by designating a portion of proceeds from artwork sales to the university development fund and departmental scholarship funds. Proceeds from small works voluntarily donated by artists will be fully accumulated into the fund. <<> The opening ceremony of the exhibition will be held on Monday, September 14 at 4 p.m. on the 1st floor of KUMA. Kyung Hee University President Kim Jin-sang, vice presidents, key administrators, and members of the College of Fine Arts will attend. At the ceremony, a report on the college's history of development, a declaration of future vision, and a scholarship fund-raising ceremony are scheduled. <<> Dean Na Hyung-min of the College of Fine Arts stated, "This 60th anniversary exhibition is a new starting point for archiving the artistic assets built over the past 60 years and nurturing creative artistic talent who will lead the next 100 years. item.title: Sejong University's University Job Plus Center Recruits Participants for '2026 Second Half Japan Employment Program' (세종대 대학일자리플러스센터, ‘2026년 하반기 일본취업반’ 참여자 모집)
item.description:
Sejong University (President Eom Jong-hwa) and its University Job Plus Center, in collaboration with the Ministry of Employment and Labor, are recruiting participants for the '2026 Second Half Japan Employment Program' to support students aspiring to work at Japanese companies in their overseas career endeavors. (세종대학교(총장 엄종화) 대학일자리플러스센터가 일본 기업 취업을 희망하는 학생들의 해외 진출을 지원하기 위해 고용노동부와 함께 ‘2026년 하반기 일본취업반’ 참여자를 모집한다.)

This program is designed to strengthen the practical skills needed for employment in Japan and to enhance understanding of local hiring procedures. It provides step-by-step support across the entire job preparation process, from practical job training to connections with interview sessions with Japanese companies. (이번 프로그램은 일본 취업에 필요한 실무 역량을 강화하고 현지 채용 절차에 대한 이해를 높이기 위해 마련됐다. 취업실전교육부터 일본 현지 기업과의 면접회 연계까지 취업 준비 전 과정을 단계적으로 지원한다.)

The Japan Employment Program focuses on helping participants understand Japanese companies' hiring methods and work environments, and on developing the ability to handle actual employment selection processes such as document preparation and interviews. In particular, the program was structured to help students who are interested in working in Japan but have found it difficult to know specific preparation methods, enabling them to build both language proficiency and practical employment skills. (일본취업반은 일본 기업의 채용 방식과 직무 환경을 이해하고 서류 작성과 면접 등 실제 채용 전형에 대응할 수 있는 역량을 기르는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 특히 일본 취업에 관심은 있지만 구체적인 준비 방법을 알기 어려웠던 학생들이 어학 능력과 취업 실무 역량을 함께 갖출 수 있도록 프로그램을 구성했다.)

The support program consists of △Practical Job Training △Connection to Japan Employment Interview Sessions △JLPT N2 Preparation Japanese Language Course. Practical Job Training and the Japan Employment Interview Session connection are required components, while the JLPT N2 preparation language course can be taken as an optional choice. (지원 프로그램은 △취업실전교육 △일본취업면접회 연계 △JLPT N2 대비 일본어 어학과정으로 구성된다. 취업실전교육과 일본취업면접회 연계는 필수 과정이며, JLPT N2 대비 어학과정은 선택해 참여할 수 있다.)

Through this, participants can receive practical employment training tailored to the hiring characteristics of Japanese companies and gain access to actual interview opportunities, thereby increasing their chances of securing a job. If needed, they can also pursue JLPT N2 preparation training in parallel to strengthen the language skills necessary for employment at Japanese companies. (이를 통해 참여자들은 일본 기업의 채용 특성에 맞춘 실전 취업교육을 받고 실제 면접 기회까지 연계해 취업 가능성을 높일 수 있다. 필요한 경우 JLPT N2 대비 교육을 병행해 일본 기업 취업에 필요한 어학 역량도 강화할 수 있다.)

The target participants are 3rd- and 4th-year current students and graduates who are eligible to join a Japanese company in 2027 or 2028. The program will run from September 8 to November 10, and those wishing to participate can apply through Sejong University's employment support system 'U-DREAM' by September 7. (모집 대상은 일본 기업에 2027년 또는 2028년 입사가 가능한 3·4학년 재학생과 졸업생이다. 프로그램은 9월 8일부터 11월 10일까지 운영되며, 참여 희망자는 9월 7일까지 세종대 취업지원시스템 ‘유드림(U-DREAM)’을 통해 신청하면 된다.)

Sejong University's University Job Plus Center has been continuously operating related programs for students hoping to work in Japan. In last year's 2025 Japan Employment Program, 5 out of 18 participants successfully secured jobs at Japanese companies. (세종대 대학일자리플러스센터는 일본 취업을 희망하는 학생들을 대상으로 관련 프로그램을 지속적으로 운영하고 있다. 지난해 진행된 2025년 일본취업반에서는 참여자 18명 가운데 5명이 실제 일본 기업 취업에 성공하는 성과를 거뒀다.)

An official from Sejong University's University Job Plus Center stated, "Since employment in Japan requires language skills, job competencies, and an understanding of local hiring procedures all at once, systematic preparation is crucial," adding, "We hope this program provides students aspiring to advance to Japan with a practical preparation opportunity and leads to actual employment." (세종대 대학일자리플러스센터 관계자는 “일본 취업은 어학 능력과 직무 역량, 현지 채용 절차에 대한 이해가 함께 요구되는 만큼 체계적인 준비가 중요하다”며 “이번 프로그램이 일본 진출을 희망하는 학생들에게 실질적인 준비 기회가 되고 실제 취업으로 이어지기를 기대한다”고 말했다.)

For further details about the program, contact Sejong University's University Job Plus Center at 02-6935-2401. (프로그램에 대한 자세한 내용은 세종대 대학일자리플러스센터(02-6935-2401)로 문의하면 된다.)

item.title: Chung-Ang University's Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film Strengthens AI Film Creation Education… Produces 10 AI Short Films (중앙대 첨단영상대학원, AI 영화 창작 교육 강화…AI 단편영화 10편 제작)
item.description:
Chung-Ang University's Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film (Dean Lee Chang-jae), which is actively integrating AI and advanced imaging technology into film and video content creation, is accelerating efforts to nurture AI film creation talent. (AI와 첨단영상기술을 영화·영상콘텐츠 창작에 적극적으로 접목하고 있는 중앙대학교 첨단영상대학원(원장 이창재)이 AI 영화 창작 인재 양성에 속도를 내고 있다.)

The 'AI FILM SPRINT 2026 SUMMER: AI Film Production Hackathon,' hosted by Chung-Ang University's Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film and the Anchor Business Project Group, and organized by the Stage 4 BK21 'Artificial Intelligence-Content Future Industry Education and Research Group' and the Graduate School of Virtual Convergence, was held from August 13 to 20 in Room 312, Building 310 at Chung-Ang University. (중앙대학교 첨단영상대학원과 앵커사업단이 주최하고, 4단계 BK21 ‘인공지능-콘텐츠 미래산업 교육연구단’과 가상융합대학원이 주관한 ‘AI FILM SPRINT 2026 SUMMER: AI 영화제작 해커톤’이 지난 8월 13일부터 20일까지 중앙대학교 310관 312호에서 진행됐다.)

For this program, ten students from the Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film, who had been invited to, screened at, or won awards at domestic and international film festivals for their short films, were selected through a script review. Over the course of one week, the participants carried out the entire film production process—including planning, image development, video generation, editing, and sound work—based on their respective scripts using generative AI, producing a total of 10 AI short films. (이번 프로그램에는 단편영화로 국내외 영화제에 초청·상영되거나 수상한 경력이 있는 첨단영상대학원 학생 10명이 시나리오 심사를 거쳐 선발됐다. 참가자들은 일주일간 각자의 시나리오를 바탕으로 생성형 AI를 활용해 기획, 이미지 개발, 영상 생성, 편집, 사운드 작업 등 영화 제작 전 과정을 수행해 총 10편의 AI 단편영화를 제작했다.)

In particular, this hackathon went beyond simple AI tool training, focusing on how to design stories and scenes suitable for AI films and how to develop character images that establish a work's distinct identity. It allowed students with existing film production experience to directly experiment with storytelling and visual expression methods suited to the new production environment of AI. (특히 이번 해커톤은 단순한 AI 툴 활용 교육을 넘어 AI 영화에 적합한 이야기와 장면을 어떻게 설계할 것인지, 작품의 개성을 형성하는 캐릭터 이미지를 어떻게 개발할 것인지에 중점을 뒀다. 기존 영화 제작 경험을 갖춘 학생들이 AI라는 새로운 제작 환경에 맞는 스토리텔링과 시각적 표현 방식을 직접 실험하도록 한 것이다.)

The participating students also experienced firsthand the differences between conventional live-action filmmaking and AI film production. Unlike live-action films, which require securing various production conditions such as shooting locations, equipment, actors, and staff, this AI film production allowed them to realize diverse spaces, characters, and scenes at a relatively low cost, while enabling repeated revisions and experimentation. (참가 학생들은 기존 극영화와 AI 영화의 제작 방식 차이도 체감했다. 촬영 장소와 장비, 배우와 스태프 등 다양한 제작 여건을 갖춰야 하는 극영화와 달리, 이번 AI 영화 제작에서는 상대적으로 적은 비용으로 다양한 공간과 캐릭터, 장면을 구현하고 반복적으로 수정·실험할 수 있었다.)

Lee Seung-hyun, a student at the Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film, said, "In live-action film work, I had to coordinate a lot of manpower, budget, and schedules to complete a single shot, but this time, the most impressive thing was being able to see the images I envisioned right away that same day." He added, "I could attempt scenes I would have given up on due to budget constraints without hesitation, and I felt that the scope of directorial choices became much wider." (이승현 첨단영상대학원 학생은 “극영화 작업에서는 한 컷을 완성하기 위해 많은 인력과 예산, 일정을 조율해야 했는데, 이번에는 구상한 이미지를 그날 바로 확인할 수 있다는 점이 가장 인상적이었다”며 “예산 때문에 포기했을 장면도 부담 없이 시도할 수 있어 연출적인 선택의 폭이 훨씬 넓어졌다고 느꼈다”고 말했다.)

The AI platform TapNow supported production credits for this program, allowing students to reduce financial burdens and focus on creation and completing their works. (이번 프로그램에는 AI 플랫폼 탭나우(TapNow)가 제작 크레딧을 지원해 학생들이 비용 부담을 덜고 창작과 작품 완성에 집중할 수 있도록 했다.)

Student Lee Min-hee, who participated in the program, shared her thoughts, saying, "It was an opportunity to learn a great deal in a short amount of time." Student Kang Eun-jung said, "Thanks to TapNow's support, I could work comfortably," and added, "I will do my best to finish the post-production well." (프로그램에 참여한 이민희 학생은 “짧은 시간 안에 많은 것을 배울 수 있는 기회였다”고 소감을 밝혔다. 강은정 학생은 “탭나우의 지원으로 편하게 작업할 수 있었다”며 “후반작업까지 마무리를 잘해보겠다”고 말했다.)

The program was co-planned and produced by Professor Choi Jung-in of Chung-Ang University's Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film, and director Kwon Ho-young, a filmmaker and professor at Sungshin Women's University. The two have worked together on various film projects since their time as students at the Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film, and have continued their collaboration in recent years, with Professor Choi Jung-in serving as a producer on several of director Kwon Ho-young's works. Building on this collaborative experience, they have recently expanded their activities into AI film production and education, jointly developing related programs. (이번 프로그램은 중앙대학교 첨단영상대학원 최정인 교수와 영화감독이자 성신여자대학교 교수인 권호영 감독이 공동 기획·프로듀싱했다. 두 사람은 첨단영상대학원 재학 시절부터 여러 영화 작업을 함께해 왔으며, 이후 최정인 교수는 권호영 감독의 여러 작품에 프로듀서로 참여하는 등 최근까지 영화 제작 협업을 이어왔다. 이러한 협업 경험을 바탕으로 최근에는 AI 영화 제작과 교육으로 활동 영역을 넓혀 관련 프로그램을 함께 만들어오고 있다.)

Director Kwon Ho-young directed commercial films such as *Parallel Life* and *Psychometry*, and last year won the Minister of Science and ICT Award for the AI film *Soul Wedding*. Professor Choi Jung-in and director Kwon Ho-young have also been appointed as jury members for domestic and international AI film festivals. (권호영 감독은 상업영화 〈평행이론〉, 〈사이코메트리〉 등을 연출했으며, 지난해 AI 영화 〈혼결(Soul Wedding)〉로 과학기술정보통신부 장관상을 수상했다. 최정인 교수와 권호영 감독은 AI 영화 제작·교육뿐 아니라 국내외 AI 영화제 심사위원으로도 위촉된 바 있다.)

Bae So-yeon, a research professor at the Chung-Ang University Anchor Business Project Group's Advanced Culture and Arts ICC who supported the operation of this program, said, "This AI film production hackathon was a program in which students completed the entire film production process—from planning to post-production—over the course of a week using generative AI, building their practical capabilities." She added, "Based on these outcomes, we will develop this into a successful model for nurturing university-based AI video creation talent." (이번 프로그램의 운영을 지원한 배소연 중앙대학교 앵커사업단 첨단문화예술ICC 연구전담교수는 “이번 AI 영화제작 해커톤은 학생들이 일주일간 생성형 AI를 활용해 기획부터 후반작업까지 영화 제작 전 과정을 완주하며 실전 역량을 키운 프로그램”이라며 “이번 성과를 바탕으로 대학 기반 AI 영상 창작 인재 양성의 성공 모델로 발전시켜 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Baek Jun-ki, the research lead of the Graduate School of Virtual Convergence, stated, "AI and virtual convergence technologies are rapidly expanding the expressive realm of video content," and noted, "The experience of applying new technologies to actual creation and completing them as a single work will be an important process that expands the possibilities of future content." (백준기 가상융합대학원 연구책임자는 “AI와 가상융합기술은 영상콘텐츠의 표현 영역을 빠르게 확장하고 있다”며 “새로운 기술을 실제 창작에 적용하고 하나의 작품으로 완성하는 경험은 미래 콘텐츠의 가능성을 확장하는 중요한 과정이 될 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Park Jin-wan, head of the Stage 4 BK21 'Artificial Intelligence-Content Future Industry Education and Research Group' at Chung-Ang University, said, "The advancement of AI technology is changing not only the way content is produced but also the way creators think," and added, "This holds great educational and research significance in that students directly experimented with the convergence possibilities of AI and content through actual work production." (박진완 중앙대학교 4단계 BK21 ‘인공지능-콘텐츠 미래산업 교육연구단’ 단장은 “AI 기술의 발전은 콘텐츠의 제작 방식뿐 아니라 창작자의 사고방식까지 변화시키고 있다”며 “학생들이 실제 작품 제작을 통해 AI와 콘텐츠의 융합 가능성을 직접 실험했다는 점에서 교육·연구적으로 의미가 크다”고 말했다.)

Lee Chang-jae, Dean of the Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film at Chung-Ang University, stated, "Based on our creative capabilities in film and video content, the Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film is actively integrating cutting-edge imaging technologies, including AI, into education, research, and creation." He added, "We will go beyond mere technology utilization to nurture creators capable of producing new stories and images, and continue to support students' experimental works so they can reach actual film festivals and the industry." (이창재 중앙대학교 첨단영상대학원장은 “첨단영상대학원은 영화와 영상콘텐츠에 대한 창작 역량을 바탕으로 AI를 비롯한 첨단영상기술을 교육과 연구, 창작에 적극적으로 접목하고 있다”며 “기술 활용에 머물지 않고 새로운 이야기와 이미지를 만들어낼 수 있는 창작자를 양성하고, 학생들의 실험적인 작품이 실제 영화제와 산업 현장으로 이어질 수 있도록 지원해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Chung-Ang University's Graduate School of Advanced Imaging Science, Multimedia and Film is continuously expanding education and research that fuses advanced imaging technologies such as AI and VFX with film and video content creation. This program was also designed as part of hands-on AI creation education that connects technical training to actual work production and film festival submissions. The 10 AI short films produced through this hackathon will undergo supplementary refinement work before being submitted sequentially to AI competition categories at domestic and international film festivals, as well as related sections introducing new forms of video works. (중앙대학교 첨단영상대학원은 AI와 VFX 등 첨단영상기술과 영화·영상콘텐츠 창작을 융합한 교육과 연구를 지속적으로 확대하고 있다. 이 프로그램 역시 기술 교육을 실제 작품 제작과 영화제 출품으로 연결하는 실전형 AI 창작 교육의 일환으로 마련됐다. 이번 해커톤을 통해 제작된 10편의 AI 단편영화는 작품별 보완 작업을 거쳐 국내외 영화제의 AI 경쟁 부문과 새로운 형식의 영상 작품을 소개하는 관련 섹션에 순차적으로 출품할 예정이다.)

item.title: Sejong University Graduate School of Business Signs ESG and Compliance Industry-Academia MOU with Korea Compliance Association (세종대 경영전문대학원, 한국컴플라이언스협회와 ESG·준법경영 산학협력 MOU 체결)
item.description:
Sejong University (President Eom Jong-hwa) Graduate School of Business signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Korea Compliance Association, a non-profit corporation, for educational and research cooperation in the fields of ESG and compliance on August 18 at 1 p.m. in Room 807 of Gwanggaeto Hall. (세종대학교(총장 엄종화) 경영전문대학원은 지난 8월 18일 오후 1시 광개토관 807호에서 사단법인 한국컴플라이언스협회와 ESG 및 컴플라이언스 분야의 교육·연구 협력을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다.)

The Korea Compliance Association is an organization established in 2023 to support the development of ESG management and compliance management systems for domestic companies. Through conferences, seminars, professional training, diagnostics and consulting, and policy research, it supports the sustainable management of companies and public institutions and strives to spread a culture of compliance. (한국컴플라이언스협회는 국내 기업의 ESG 경영과 준법경영 체계 구축을 지원하기 위해 2023년 설립된 단체다. 컨퍼런스와 세미나, 전문교육, 진단 및 컨설팅, 정책연구 등을 통해 기업과 공공기관의 지속가능경영을 지원하고 컴플라이언스 문화 확산에 힘쓰고 있다.)

The signing ceremony was attended by Lee Seong-hoon, Associate Dean of the Graduate School of Business at Sejong University (Lead Professor of the Franchise MBA), Yang Jae-jang, Lead Professor of the ESG MBA (Master's in ESG Management), and Kim Eun-seong, Chairman of the Korea Compliance Association, who discussed the direction of cooperation between the two institutions and future development plans. (이날 협약식에는 세종대 경영전문대학원 이성훈 부원장(프랜차이즈 MBA 주임교수), ESG MBA(ESG 경영 석사) 양재장 주임교수, 한국컴플라이언스협회 김은성 이사장이 참석해 양 기관의 협력 방향과 향후 발전 방안을 논의했다.)

Under this agreement, the two institutions will pursue △cooperation in education and research in the fields of compliance and ESG management △development of educational programs to strengthen corporate legal and ethical management capabilities △joint implementation of academic and educational programs such as seminars, forums, and special lectures △establishment of industry-academia networks and expert exchanges △mutual cooperation for fostering field-oriented professional talent, among other initiatives. (이번 협약에 따라 양 기관은 △컴플라이언스 및 ESG 경영 분야 교육·연구 협력 △기업의 준법·윤리경영 역량 강화를 위한 교육 프로그램 개발 △세미나·포럼·특강 등 학술·교육 프로그램 공동 추진 △산학 네트워크 구축 및 전문가 교류 △현장 중심의 전문인재 양성을 위한 상호 협력 등을 추진한다.)

As social demands for corporate sustainable management have recently increased and related laws and regulations have been strengthened, the importance of professionals who can effectively integrate ESG and compliance into actual management strategies and organizational operations is also growing. (최근 기업의 지속가능경영에 대한 사회적 요구가 높아지고 관련 법규와 제도가 강화되면서 ESG와 컴플라이언스를 실제 경영전략과 조직 운영에 효과적으로 접목할 수 있는 전문인력의 중요성도 커지고 있다.)

Accordingly, the two institutions plan to establish a practical industry-academia cooperation system that bridges education and the industrial field by linking the educational and research capabilities in ESG management held by Sejong University's Graduate School of Business with the compliance expertise and industry network of the Korea Compliance Association. In particular, they will join forces to foster ESG and compliance professionals required in the field through joint educational programs and expert exchanges. (이에 양 기관은 세종대 경영전문대학원이 보유한 ESG 경영 분야의 교육·연구 역량과 한국컴플라이언스협회의 컴플라이언스 전문성 및 산업 네트워크를 연계해 교육과 산업 현장을 잇는 실질적인 산학협력 체계를 구축할 계획이다. 특히 공동 교육 프로그램과 전문가 교류 등을 통해 현장에서 요구되는 ESG·컴플라이언스 전문인력 양성에도 힘을 모을 예정이다.)

With this agreement as a momentum, Sejong University's Graduate School of Business plans to expand related education and research so that ESG and compliance can establish themselves as core management elements that enhance corporate sustainability and competitiveness, going beyond simple regulatory responses. (세종대 경영전문대학원은 이번 협약을 계기로 ESG와 컴플라이언스가 단순한 규제 대응을 넘어 기업의 지속가능성과 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 경영요소로 자리 잡을 수 있도록 관련 교육과 연구를 확대할 계획이다.)

The Korea Compliance Association likewise plans to support the spread of legal and ethical management culture in companies and institutions based on cooperation with the university, and jointly pursue education and research projects for nurturing compliance professionals and applying ESG management in the field. (한국컴플라이언스협회 역시 대학과의 협력을 바탕으로 기업과 기관의 준법·윤리경영 문화 확산을 지원하고, 컴플라이언스 전문인력 양성과 ESG 경영의 현장 적용을 위한 교육·연구 사업을 공동 추진할 예정이다.)

item.title: Amid tariff barriers, 'local production' strategy: Hyundai Steel and POSCO break ground on first low-carbon steel mill in the U.S. (관세 장벽에 ‘현지 생산’으로…현대제철·포스코, 미 저탄소 제철소 첫 삽)
item.description:
Hyundai Steel and POSCO will jointly build an electric arc furnace steel mill in Louisiana, U.S. The mill will produce approximately 2.7 million tons annually of automotive steel sheets and other products, which will be supplied to Hyundai Motor and Kia's North American production bases. With U.S. steel tariff barriers rising, Korean steel companies are establishing local production footholds to secure competitiveness in the high-value-added North American steel market. (현대제철과 포스코가 미국 루이지애나주에 전기로 제철소를 함께 짓는다. 이 제철소는 연간 270만톤 규모의 자동차 강판 등을 생산해 현대차·기아의 북미 생산기지에 공급할 예정이다. 미국의 철강 관세 장벽이 높아지는 가운데, 한국 철강기업들이 북미 고부가 철강 시장에서 경쟁력을 확보하고자 현지 생산 거점 마련에 나선 것이다.)

The two companies held a groundbreaking ceremony for the Louisiana electric arc furnace steel mill on the 4th at 3:00 p.m. local time in Donaldsonville, Louisiana. The mill is one of the core projects of the Hyundai Motor Group's investment plan for the U.S. announced last year. In March of last year, the group announced it would invest $21 billion in the U.S. by 2028, unveiling a plan to expand U.S. production and strengthen its supply chain by sourcing steel and auto parts locally. In August of that year, it expanded the investment to $26 billion. <<> Hyundai Steel announced it would build a $5.8 billion electric arc furnace steel mill specializing in automotive steel sheets in Louisiana. POSCO Group also joined the project through equity participation, broadening its scope from a Hyundai Motor Group materials supply chain investment to a joint North American local production project by Korea's leading steelmakers. Under the structure, Hyundai Steel and POSCO will build a low-carbon steel production base in the U.S., with the automotive steel sheets produced there to be supplied to Hyundai Motor and Kia plants in the southern U.S. and Mexico. The mill is expected to begin commercial production around 2029. <<> The U.S. is a net importer of steel, unable to meet all its demand through domestic production alone. According to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, U.S. steel market demand this year is projected at 90.87 million tons, exceeding domestic production of 81.9 million tons. However, the U.S. has been raising barriers to foreign steel products through tariffs under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act and various trade remedy measures. Indeed, in March of last year, the U.S. abolished existing exemptions that had applied to steel, and in June raised the steel tariff rate under Section 232 to 50%. <<> In this trade environment, local production in the U.S. has become a key response strategy for Korean steelmakers. Since exporting steel products from Korea to the U.S. makes it difficult to avoid tariff burdens, they are seeking to secure production bases within the U.S. to stably enter the high-value-added North American steel market. Hyundai Motor and Kia will also be able to source automotive steel sheets within North America, enhancing supply security and supply chain competitiveness. <<> Louisiana, where the steel mill will be built, offers Mississippi River waterway access, port infrastructure, and abundant energy resources. With a high share of natural gas-fired power generation and industrial electricity rates below the U.S. average, the location is considered favorable for an electric arc furnace steel mill, which consumes large amounts of electricity. Easy access for importing raw materials and exporting finished products, as well as proximity to major automotive production hubs in the southern U.S., are additional advantages. <<> The Louisiana mill will produce high-grade steel products such as automotive steel sheets using an electric arc furnace-based process rather than a traditional blast furnace. Unlike conventional methods that use coal-based coke in the iron ore reduction process, the plan is to utilize natural gas from the southern U.S. combined with electric arc furnace processing to reduce carbon emissions. The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy estimates this approach could cut carbon emissions by approximately 70% compared to traditional blast furnace operations. <<> Carbon emissions from steel have also emerged as a critical issue for the automaker industry. As the transition to electric vehicles accelerates, there is growing pressure to reduce carbon emissions not only during vehicle operation but also at the raw material production stage. If automotive steel sheets can be produced and supplied through low-carbon methods, it will also help automakers meet the carbon reduction standards across the supply chain they face. The government and industry believe that if clean hydrogen becomes more cost-competitive in the future, natural gas could be replaced with hydrogen to further reduce carbon emissions. <<> However, tariff burdens remain a variable for the large-scale local investment to proceed as planned. A considerable number of equipment and materials needed for plant construction are difficult to procure within the U.S., and tariffs on these items could increase the initial investment burden. <<> Prior to the groundbreaking ceremony, Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Ahn Duk-geun met with Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry and explained that Korean companies' investments in the U.S. are contributing to Korea-U.S. supply chain cooperation and the strengthening of U.S. manufacturing. Minister Ahn requested that the U.S. federal and state governments provide support to resolve investment difficulties for Korean companies, including reducing tariff burdens on plant equipment and materials that are hard to source locally. <<> A ministry official said, "Amid the rapidly changing global trade environment, we will actively pursue necessary support, including resolving trade and investment difficulties, to help our companies preempt overseas markets and build stable supply chains." <<> Yoo Ha-young, Reporter yhy@hani.co.kr ( 두 회사는 4일 오후 3시(현지시각) 미국 루이지애나주 도널드슨빌에서 루이지애나 전기로 제철소 기공식을 열었다. 이 제철소는 현대차그룹이 지난해 내놓은 대미 투자 계획의 핵심 사업 가운데 하나다. 현대차그룹은 지난해 3월 2028년까지 미국에 210억달러를 투자하겠다고 밝히며, 미국 내 생산 확대와 함께 철강·자동차 부품까지 현지에서 조달하는 공급망 강화 구상을 내놨다. 이후 그해 8월에는 투자 규모를 260억달러로 확대했다.)
